boundary: Local Juiced Platform adapter and live Cantelop Edge; no hosted Juiced deployment

hostedRelayBaseline.boundary: Production Juiced relay from California; missing-workspace metadata inspection, no VM activation

hostLookup.boundary: Compute HTTP completion logs for the probes

limitations: Candidate measurements run the actual Juiced Platform adapter locally against live Cantelop, not a deployed Juiced service.
First sample per variant is reported separately and excluded from warm medians. Five warm samples are diagnostic evidence, not a latency SLO.
Workspace production was absent in the measured App. These calls inspect metadata without creating a Workspace, starting a Sandbox, or inspecting files.
The cache only saves setup on the same service process within 30 seconds. First use and cold service processes still fetch status and credentials.
Every command still reaches Edge. Separate direct-Edge probes had 1.66-second and 3.30-second outliers while corresponding host lookups remained below 0.3 ms. This patch does not fix that latency.

Fleet principal changes are rechecked on the next transport acquisition, at most 30 seconds after a successful cache fill; existing SDK connections already retain their App credential. User/device authorization and Edge credential/runtime admission remain per request.
